title: GUI fidelity: verify Supply army when the selected fleet carries the army
body:
Requested by the owner after v0.8.2 during the GUI provenance audit. The [promoted supply report](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial-conquest-2-research/blob/865755e04f107afc38cdb496669d882e2551aca6/docs/reports/2026-10-09-supply-providers-and-transfer-clamps.md) explicitly leaves “An army aboard a fleet as Supply army's target (the selected-fleet branch of 0x446f50)” unestablished.

The remake [OpenSupplyArmyDialog](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial_conquest_2/blob/4d70275aac4e155c0370a3ee23525cf34450a908/godot/UI/MainGameScreen.cs#L1215) resolves SelectedArmyOrCarried(), queries providers around the army's coordinates, and opens SupplyDialog with that ArmyId. This is plausible and partly code-backed, but the original dialog's actual target, provider context and resource movements need a bounded original-side check. Do not infer them from the separate fact that army orders can resolve a carried army.

Questions / experiment:
- Trace the selected-fleet branch of TUnitMap_SupplyArmy (0x446f50), target binding and TAFSupply initialization/commit callbacks.
- Use one fleet carrying one army, with distinct army/carrier supplies and money. Add one eligible city and another own fleet nearby so wrong-target/provider choices are detectable.
- Invoke Army > Supply army with the carrier selected. Record dialog identity, displayed balances, providers, target and each changed record after a small supply/money transfer; compare Fleet > Supply fleet as a control.
- Check carrier alone, carrier plus city, carrier plus other fleet, full versus depleted carried army, and a moved carrier (to expose stale army coordinates). Determine whether the carrier can supply its own embarked army and whether city reach uses carrier or army coordinates.
- Record immediate versus OK-applied changes and Cancel behavior. Distinguish no-provider refusal from selection failure.

Do not broaden into AI embarked-army auto-resupply (already researched separately), army-to-army QoL, or an unbounded end-to-end campaign.

Deliver a bounded report with exact original EXE/runtime identity, code sites, control matrix, observations versus inference, evidence locations and explicit limits. Use separate synthetic/private copies, preserve source files, and keep original bytes/screenshots/private save hashes out of public GitHub. Coordinate any native Windows execution with the owner; do not interrupt a running game. Research only: no remake implementation or automatic design changes.
